_comment: Workbook exercise plant-heat-pump (docs/workbook/plant-heat-pump.md): defrost, operating mode, capacity, same-room imbalance, compressor staging and the source loop on the synthetic-heat-pump units (generated by CAMBER, no real building), at the trend's own 5-minute resolution and the rules' defaults: heatpump_defrost warns at 24 and faults at 48 reversals a day, compressor_staging at 24 and 48 stage changes a day, source_loop_deltat judges against a 10 F design delta-T. The topology declares the two rooms that two water-source units share (ROOM_A: the classroom pair, ROOM_B: the window-side and door-side units), which hp_room_imbalance needs. The variants plant-heat-pump--15min (the same data resampled to 15 minutes) and plant-heat-pump--20rev (a 20-reversals-a-day limit) run fewer rules.
